question_en: After repairing a motor starter, what is required?
options: Test the starter assembly for correct operation.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: The starter assembly is to be tested after repair and against manufacturer/facility requirements.
explanation_es: El conjunto del starter debe probarse después de la reparación según requisitos del fabricante y la instalación.
